name: The Ryan Bros.

tenures.source: Anarchy of 26 August 2010, whose result line reads 'WINNERS: THE RYAN BROS.' in a tag match with Hunter Ryan and Nick Ryan on one side, and the funeral page, where Nick Ryan walks over to 'his brother Hunter'

caption: Hunter Ryan and Nick Ryan, billed together as the Ryan Bros. on the Anarchy of 26 August 2010 and as a tag team on the 12 August 2010 card.

name: The Initiative

tenures.source: Massacre of 1 December 2008, which bills Nick Ryan as 'of The Initiative', and the funeral page, where Nick Ryan lays an Initiative t-shirt on the casket

caption: A group the fed's pages tie to Nick Ryan; no page names its members.

name: N.O.W.

tenures.source: the funeral page, where Trent Gein says Famine of the Vile 'has named me the new leader of the N.O.W.'

caption: A stable led by Famine of the Vile; the funeral page says Trent Gein succeeds him as leader.

name: Hardcore Smitty & Outsider Stone

tenures.source: Massacre of 9 February 2009, which bills them as a tag team opposite Hunter Ryan and Brian Cady, and Massacre of 26 January 2009, which sets them against one another

caption: Billed as a tag team on 9 February 2009, and as opponents in the 'King Of The Snubs' match of 26 January 2009.

name: The Dynasty

tenures.source: Massacre of 29 December 2008, which names its remaining members as Brady Anderson, Trent Gein, Megan Byron, Sam Hain, Jaymz Dante and Shawn Hunt

caption: A stable whose members the 29 December 2008 Massacre lists by name; only Trent Gein is a character on this wing.

identity.note: The same name stands on other wings' records; nothing on this wing's pages ties this group to any of them.
